guarantees.claim: key_dec_d is assigned key_expand_out when key_dec_sel equals KEY_DEC_EXPAND or KEY_DEC_CLEAR; otherwise assigned prd_clearing_key_i.

assumptions.claim: When key_dec_sel takes a value other than KEY_DEC_EXPAND or KEY_DEC_CLEAR, prd_clearing_key_i must provide a safe cleared key value.
assumptions.risk: If prd_clearing_key_i is not a safe cleared key, key_dec_d may output sensitive material or invalid key data.

uncertain_points.claim: KEY_DEC_CLEAR mode selects key_expand_out, which may contain sensitive key material, contradicting the likely intent to output a cleared key (e.g., prd_clearing_key_i).
uncertain_points.risk: Sensitive key data may be passed to key_dec_d when clearing was expected, leading to potential key leakage.
